FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
FAQ.subtitle: Some questions often asked by our prospective clients.
FAQ.q1: How long does it take to build a website or app?
FAQ.a1: Development time depends heavily on project complexity. Standard company profile websites take 2-4 weeks, while custom apps or complex e-commerce platforms can take 2-4 months.
FAQ.q2: Does Eldorado Tech provide maintenance services after project completion?
FAQ.a2: Yes, we provide monthly or annual support and maintenance packages to ensure your system remains secure, up-to-date, and runs optimally.
FAQ.q3: What technologies do you usually use?
FAQ.a3: We use modern tech stacks such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and Cloud architectures (AWS/GCP). However, technology selection is always tailored to each project's specific needs.
FAQ.q4: What is the payment system for development services?
FAQ.a4: We apply a milestone system agreed upon at the start of the contract. It's usually divided into 3 stages: Down Payment (30%), Mid-Project (40%), and Final Settlement upon handover (30%).
